title: tapper keg config
description: Schema for keg metadata stored in a keg repository config file.

updated.description: RFC3339 timestamp indicating when the keg metadata was last updated.

url.description: Primary URL for the keg or project.

creator.description: Creator identifier, profile URL, or repository URL.

state.description: Lifecycle state for the keg, such as living or archived.

summary.description: Short summary of the keg's purpose and contents.

instructions.description: Markdown guidance for agents working in this keg.

links.description: Named external links or related keg references.

alias.description: Unique alias used to reference the link.

indexes.description: Configured index outputs and optional tag filters.

file.description: Bare filename of the generated index artifact (e.g. "backlinks", "concepts.md"); the on-disk path is always under the keg's dex/ directory and the prefix is applied at write time.

summary.description: Short description of what this index contains.

query.description: Boolean query expression to filter index contents. Supports tag names, key=value attribute predicates, dot-prefix stats fields (.created>2026-01-01, .accessCount>=5, .omega>=0.8), and boolean operators (and/or/not).

sort.description: Sort order for query-filtered index entries.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for resolving ambiguous timestamps within this keg (e.g. America/Chicago). Defaults to UTC.

mode.description: Automatic snapshot mode. "auto" lets hub servers snapshot idle changed nodes; "off" disables automatic snapshots for this keg.

idleAfter.description: Idle window before an automatic snapshot is eligible, formatted as a Go duration such as 1h or 30m.

schemaPolicy.description: Schema validation behavior for write actors. Defaults: human warns; agent and API block. Archive imports and snapshot restores always skip node-schema enforcement.
